scope: generated fallback outdoor-unit fan face only
reconstructionBasis: Conservative manufacturer-neutral reconstruction of a late-1990s/circa-2000 Japanese balcony condenser fan face. Dimensions below are benchmark assumptions, not a claim about a specific maker/model.

rotor.geometry: five swept/tapered finite-thickness axial blades behind the guard; no opaque disc proxy
rotor.mounting: rotor centered on existing condenser motor/hub axis
rotor.orientation: fan plane parallel to condenser front face; stopped clock angle varies deterministically by unit

wireGuard.geometry: round-section concentric wire rings plus round-section radial spokes with flat finite ends; 48-segment ring paths and 12-sided 5 mm wire sections reduce polygonal specular stepping in native-4K grazing crops; replaces square bar lattice and forbids rectangular spoke strips
wireGuard.mounting: front of rotor with positive axial separation; four formed galvanized mounting feet physically bridge the air gap to the shroud

guardMountInterface.construction: four formed/welded galvanized circular mounting feet/standoffs aligned to diagonal radial spokes; benchmark reconstruction rather than model-specific hardware
guardMountInterface.geometryVsMaterialDetail: mount thickness, axial bridge and seating are geometry; oxidation/dulling remain material/weathering response
guardMountInterface.purpose: prevent the wire guard from reading as unsupported/floating while preserving the real axial air gap around the rest of the guard

materials.microstructure: subtle injection-molded polymer grain inherited from AC polymer family; no painted highlight
materials.uvAging: mild surface dulling only because rotor is recessed
materials.angularFresnelResponse: broad dielectric edge lift; never metallic

materials.microstructure: subtle aged zinc/steel surface; physical circular wire and mounting geometry supply the grazing highlight, never a painted line
materials.angularFresnelResponse: metallic grazing reflection broadened by aging and circular wire curvature

weathering.rotor: recess grime and mild UV exposure only
weathering.shroud: UV dulling plus recess dust; rain exposure at outward lip
weathering.guard: rain/UV exposure; ferrous-source aging only, no arbitrary rust
weathering.guardMounts: same rain/UV/ferrous causality as guard because feet are exposed galvanized steel; no contact grime invented solely for visibility

lodPolicy.LOD0: shroud + five-blade rotor + full four-ring/eight-spoke round-wire guard + four physical guard mounts
lodPolicy.LOD1: shroud + rotor + full round-wire guard + guard mounts retained with canonical meshes
lodPolicy.LOD2: shroud + rotor retained; wire guard and mounting feet removed before they alias
lodPolicy.LOD3: shroud only preserves circular intake silhouette; rotor/guard/mounts removed

formalBuildBinding.reason: The formal 4K chain reaches Danchi LOD generation through tree/foliage/ground preparation; physical fan, refined guard and its mounting interface must exist before proxy creation and remain direct dependencies of the final Danchi validation entrypoint.

inspect: round-wire grazing highlight rather than flat-strip highlight
polygonal specular stepping on 5 mm wire
physical guard-mount seating and any unsupported/floating read
guard repetition across fifteen balcony units
LOD1-to-LOD2 guard/mount disappearance for pop or shimmer
